observation: Each controller stopped new submissions after one terminal broker_fault. Two refusals happened before any device work and cannot provide an accepted-job line. The third has complete typed candidate resource evidence but no EvaluationReceipt. The earlier sibling-isolation predicate additionally compared byte metadata with a truncated integer-KB rendering and rejected16320 versus16KB. Frozen C1 results remain faults.
proposed_change: Add a typed EvaluationRefusal and a versioned evaluation_refused event, independent of EvaluationReceipt. Preserve one retained attempt and the original Ralph evaluation and time budgets. Deliver allocation or candidate-resource feedback to the next turn without automatic retry. A missing attribution cannot qualify that turn for nomination. Reconstruct refusals from raw attempts in independent replay. Unknown errors, partial dispatch, missing cleanup, wrong candidate/target/case and terminal confirmation refusals remain hard faults.
promotion_disposition: Lab and Evaluation protocol evolution only. No IR, lowering, Workload, oracle, timer, GPU limit or compiler-performance promotion. The provider remains v7. Existing receipt and failed-worker schemas remain readable, while the new refusal has its own schema_version. Preserve every live and sealed C1 Run. CPU verification must include the two real failure forms, a continuing Run, author feedback, independent replay and negative cases before successor use.
